purpose: Supplementary training with an explicitly recorded seed; neither recovery of the historical seed nor replacement of frozen formal outputs
seed_policy: Reset Python/NumPy/PyTorch seeds to 123 in each target-specific process; do not increment by target index

runtime_amendment.reason: The first pilot failed at step 0 while writing HDF logs because PyTables was missing; install the required training dependency and retry from an empty directory rather than resuming the failed cache
runtime_amendment.packages: Add PyTables 3.9.2 and dependencies; hdf5=1.14.3, h5py=3.13.0; retain MKL 2022.1.0 and unchanged torch/NumPy/pandas versions; full builds are in the lockfile
runtime_amendment.numexpr_note: MKL 2022.1.0 constrains numexpr to 2.7.3; pandas disables this optional accelerator automatically; HDF log writing and reading were tested successfully

data_policy: Retain original staged input.h5ad/features and saved merged configurations; no resampling or renormalization

training.checkpoint_selection: Retain the original fixed-budget training procedure's MMD-selected model.pt; do not select checkpoints using endpoint scores

pilot.selection: Alphabetically first HCC38 target, selected independently of endpoint/model results
pilot.acceptance: Exact elementwise agreement of all model and optimizer states, step counts, and exported shifts for best/last checkpoints

full_run.incomplete_cache_policy: No automatic resume: original CellOT checkpoints do not save RNG states; retain failed-run records and investigate before deciding on another attempt
full_run.promotion_policy: Compare all 94 completed fits together; do not select a better seed/context/target to replace formal results

scoring.inference: Retain frozen score_context settings of 5000 bootstrap and 10000 Mantel iterations, plus the M4 endpoint permutation definition and base seeds
scoring.bh_policy: Use a separate two-context family for new outputs; leave the original 18-test family unchanged and do not compare performance using old versus new q values
scoring.difference_policy: Describe new-minus-old differences per dimension; do not claim between-model difference testing or training-seed stability
